obligations.statement: The stand must have three legs that can fold in close to the body, achieving a narrow and compact configuration.
All components must remain attached to the stand when folded.
No parts may be removed or loose when folding or unfolding.
The stand must be openable by hand with an intuitive, sensible sequence.
When open, the three legs must spread apart in different directions to provide a usable footprint on the desk.
Nothing may come apart or fall off during opening, and no tools, motor, or other equipment may be required.
Once open, the stand must remain open without external support.
While in use, the legs must not fold back, twist aside, or come off without deliberate action.
No unintended movement of the stand or its parts should occur.
Folding requires a deliberate action, and the stand must not collapse from a knock.
After deliberate release, the stand must fold to the same compact shape it started in.
The opening and folding sequence must be repeatable, with all normal parts remaining attached.
The stand must hold a small object on a desk while the user works.
The stand must be assemblable in a sensible order and stay together through normal use.
The stand must provide support for the small object without collapsing or excessive deflection.
The stand must withstand the weight of a small object while in use without failure.
The stand must be manufacturable with appropriate materials and processes.
The legs must move relative to the body to fold and unfold, requiring appropriate joints.
The stand must maintain its open configuration and resist unintended folding unless deliberately released.
The components must be held together so that they do not separate under normal use and folding.
The stand must have a stable footprint on the desk when open.
The opening and folding sequence must be achievable with one hand in a natural order.
The stand must not require excessive force to operate.
The stand must not rely on external devices for motion or locking.
The product must be assemblable without special tools beyond normal assembly equipment.
The folding motion must not self-actuate due to gravity or vibration.
The stability of the stand when open must be robust to knocks and normal use.
There must be no requirement to disassemble the stand for storage or transport.

unresolved.decision: Choice of locking mechanism principle for preventing unintended folding.
unresolved.why_open: Multiple locking mechanisms (over-centre, friction, detent) could satisfy the obligations, but the input ambiguities and freedoms do not specify which is preferred or feasible.

assumptions.statement: The stand is intended for stationary use on a stable desk surface; it does not need to withstand dynamic loads beyond normal handling.
assumptions.why: The requirement mentions holding an object while working, implying static support on a desk.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the stand is used on uneven or moving surfaces, or subjected to significant external forces.

assumptions.statement: The user is an adult with typical hand strength and dexterity.
assumptions.why: The requirement states opening by hand without tools, implying manual operation.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the intended users include children or individuals with limited hand strength, requiring lower forces.

assumptions.statement: The small object to be held is within a typical size and weight range for desk items (e.g., phone, small notebook, photo frame).
assumptions.why: The requirement specifies 'small object' without further quantification.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the object's weight or size exceeds what the stand can support, necessitating larger or stronger design.
